description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among all requests. ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters.

>  If you do not set this parameter, the system uses **RequestId** as **ClientToken**. The value of **RequestId** for each API request may be different.
The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。默认值：**10**。取值范围：**1**~**50**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.

description.zh:
IPsec连接所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent list of regions.

description.zh:
路由条目类型。取值：

- **custom**（默认值）：目的路由条目。
- **bgp**：BGP路由条目。
description.en:
The route type. Valid values:

*   **custom** (default): a destination-based route
*   **bgp**: a BGP route
The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

title.zh: 查询IPsec连接下路由条目的信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-vco-route-entries --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-connection-id vco-p0w2jpkhi2eeop6q60000 --route-entry-type custom --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-42660000 --region cn-hangzhou
